verdict.rationale: Muse is a personal AI agent, so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence says users can plug in MCP servers. The closest items are Muse writing its own custom connectors for services with APIs or CLIs and linking first-party apps like email and calendar. Those are adjacent capabilities, not MCP client support. The probe finding of no MCP server card concerns the server role and does not bear on this story.
